$schema-comment: Canonical behavior contract for FunnelOrchestrator on both platforms. Each scenario asserts the full forward step sequence given a starting set of answers and an optional register event. Loaded by iOS FunnelOrchestratorTests.swift and Android FunnelOrchestratorTest.kt; both must produce expectedSequence verbatim. v5 redesign: routing branches on chair_rise_capability (with_handles -> standingComfort, else challengeArea). painStats ('אתה לא לבד') was removed from the flow; body-areas now goes straight to plan-building regardless of pain_areas. See ADR-0001.

scenarios.name: independent_branch_with_pain_standard
scenarios.description: Chair-rise alone/with_support -> challengeArea branch; body-areas -> plan-building (painStats removed); phone OTP.

scenarios.name: independent_branch_no_pain_standard
scenarios.description: Chair-rise with_support -> challengeArea branch; body-areas -> plan-building (painStats removed).

scenarios.name: assisted_branch_with_pain_standard
scenarios.description: Chair-rise with_handles -> standingComfort branch (influencing); body-areas -> plan-building (painStats removed); phone OTP.

scenarios.name: assisted_branch_apple
scenarios.description: with_handles -> standingComfort; Apple Sign-In bypasses OTP (register -> payment).

scenarios.name: independent_null_pain_standard
scenarios.description: Null pain_areas: body-areas -> plan-building (painStats removed). Pins Swift(nil)/Kotlin(null) parity.
